noun_definition: Search refers to the feature in the New Expensify app that allows users to find and manage expenses within their account.
select mode refers to the state in the Expensify app that allows users to select expenses for actions such as deletion, which should automatically exit when there are no expenses left to select.
state screen refers to the interface displayed when there are no expenses available to select in the search mode of the New Expensify app.
Expenses refer to the financial entries recorded in the account that represent amounts owed for unpaid transactions.
